d:
Kangres, samajvadi parti, tiemsi samet kaee vipakshi dal dilli ke ramlila maidan men ek bari raili karne ja rahe hain. raili ko samarthan dene desh ke alag-alag hisson se vipakshi partiyon ke samarthak jutne lage hain. bibisi sanvaddata dilanvaz pasha ne in logon se bat ki.
Shut: shad midhat
Edit: nimit vats
BBC World Service ke nae aip ko daunlod karen.
BBC News hindi ko chunen aur paie nyuz alart, laiv tivi, podkast... sab ek jagah.
(kripya not karen: naya aip briten aur amerika men uplabdh nahin hai.)
• bibisi hindi se aap in soshal midiya chainals par bhi jur sakte hain-
